sources.entry: Transcribe Video: To The Text - iPhone app that transcribes video and audio files, YouTube or Vimeo links and live voice recordings, with speaker labels, a one-tap summary and TXT/DOCX export. #freemium #transcription

summary.name: To The Text
summary.one_liner: An iOS app that turns video files, audio files, or live microphone speech into editable text transcripts.
use_cases: converting podcasts or voice memos to text
summary.what_it_does: The app transcribes three input types: video files, audio files, and live speech captured through the microphone. It produces a readable transcript with language detection, which can be copied, shared, or exported as TXT or DOCX. Transcripts are saved in an in-app library for later use. The page says conversion of a first recording takes under a minute. The page is marketing-focused and does not describe accuracy metrics, supported languages, or privacy details.
notable: Accepts video, audio, and live voice as inputs
Exports transcripts as TXT or DOCX
Saves every transcription in an in-app library
Speaker labels and one-tap summary are mentioned in the listing (not on the page text)
caveats: Listed as free to try; paid tiers are not described on the page
Only an iOS app is named; no Android, web, or desktop version is mentioned
